privacy.retention: No personal data is stored by this site. Aggregate counters are kept as long as the statistics page exists.

edge._comment: Download counter (site/edge). Empty: buttons link to the GitHub files and counts come from stats.json. Set to the worker origin (https://...): buttons use <origin>/dl/<asset>, the home map reads <origin>/stats, and connect-src allows that origin. Regenerate after changing it.
